description_en: Modifies the cache reserve configuration for a site
description_zh: 修改站点缓存保持配置
name: UpdateCacheReserve

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the feature. Valid values:

on: Enables the feature.
off: shutdown.

You must explicitly specify the Enable parameter when you invoke this operation. If this parameter is not specified, the operation returns the InvalidParameter.Configs fault, which indicates a configuration parameter fault. shutdown (off) also requires the site plan to support the cache reserve feature. If the plan does not support this feature, the operation returns the FunctionQuotaCheckFailed fault, which indicates that the current plan does not support the restricted function
parameters.help_zh:
开关。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭。

调用本接口时需显式提供 Enable，未提供时接口返回 InvalidParameter.Configs（配置参数错误）。关闭（off）同样要求站点套餐支持缓存保持功能，不支持时返回 FunctionQuotaCheckFailed（当前套餐不支持配置受限功能）
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cache reserve instance. The value is the instance identity returned after you purchase the cache reserve feature.

You must specify this parameter when Enable is set to on. If this parameter is not specified, the operation returns the InvalidParameter.Configs fault, which indicates a configuration parameter fault
parameters.help_zh:
缓存保持实例ID，取值为购买缓存保持后返回的实例标识。

Enable 为 on 时必须提供该参数；该参数缺失时接口返回 InvalidParameter.Configs（配置参数错误）
parameters.name: cache_reserve_instance_id
